title: Vivid Mediterranean Pasta
description: A simple yet flavorful dish that combines the crunch of vivid ingredients with the taste of the Mediterranean.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the crispy capers and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the vivid cherry tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until they start to release their juices.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Combine the cooked pappardelle and the skillet mixture, and toss to combine.
